Team — quick, focused request as finance is locking the May forecast this week. We need a concise R/Y/G export for ACME (deal RINF-ACM-2027-Q2-001) by EOD Tue so FP&A and RevOps can finalize commit. Please:

- Populate the attached forecast_snapshot_may02.csv with your latest probability & ARR impact.
- Call out any active blockers and put them into the save-plan format (owner / next action / deadline).

I started a draft Mutual Action Plan (attachment: ACME_MutualActionPlan_v2.docx) with proposed milestones — if you have legal or procurement redlines, add them as comments directly.

Red flags to prioritize:
- Procurement hold (means we need a price/term exemption)
- Technical pilot scope creep (scope beyond what we committed)
- Legal SLA exceptions requiring legal review (long lead)

I want a one-slide summary for finance: 3 bullets per R/Y/G list (owner + immediate ask). If a deal is red, include a recommended action (credit, demo, exec sync).

Thanks — I’ll run a 20-min sync Tue 10:30am if needed.

— Olga
